name: Kimpton Hotel Monaco Philadelphia
positioning: Historic-building Kimpton hotel in Old City Philadelphia, just steps from the Liberty Bell, with a rooftop lounge and Red Owl Tavern
best_for: Travelers who want to walk to Philadelphia's historic sights
Guests traveling with pets of any size

facts.text: The hotel is just steps from Independence Park, the Liberty Bell and the Betsy Ross House.
The hotel is an adaptive reuse project of an historic building.
The hotel is housed in the former Lafayette Building of Old City, Philadelphia.
Red Owl Tavern is a three-meal tavern whose menu gives regional favorites a global spin.
Stratus Rooftop Lounge is an indoor/outdoor rooftop spot above the Liberty Bell Center.
Pets of any size, weight or breed are welcome at no extra charge.
The hotel offers custom-designed bikes to ride around the neighborhood.
Rooms are outfitted with 300-thread-count Frette linens and Atelier Bloem amenities.
Condé Nast Traveler listed the hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards in 2018, 2021, 2024 and 2025.

highlights.text: The rooftop patio has a 30-foot fireplace and a DJ booth.
A wall of antique calligraphy pens stands behind the front desk.
Each Spa Room has a deep, vintage soaking tub and a standalone shower.
The hotel is housed in the former Lafayette Building of Old City, Philadelphia.

considerations.text: The hotel does not have a pool.
Overnight valet parking is available for $61 plus tax.
There is no complimentary local area shuttle.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: Kimpton Hotel Monaco Philadelphia
